themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and research that assist in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often acting as intelligent co-pilots for developers.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Details various AI-powered platforms, software, and frameworks designed to support and accelerate scientific and product research.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI applications directly assisting in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to interface design and creative asset generation.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Encompasses AI's role in creating various forms of content, including text, images, audio, and video, for marketing, design, and other applications.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries, particularly for research and meeting insights.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Covers the testing, comparison, and assessment of various AI tools and platforms based on performance, usability, and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting employment, job roles, skills requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of simulated users for testing and research purposes, their effectiveness, and limitations compared to human users.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Highlights platforms and ecosystems built to facilitate and manage AI research, development, and deployment.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
